scripts.check: npm run koka:build && npm run koka:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run lint:fixtures && npm run check:rules && npm run check:dts && npm run check:gates && npm run check:koka && npm test
scripts.koka:check: git diff --exit-code -- examples/ingest/boundary/ingest.ffi.ts examples/ingest/effects/ingest.drive.ts examples/fulfil/boundary/fulfil.ffi.ts examples/fulfil/effects/fulfil.drive.ts || (echo 'the FFI is generated from the core; commit what koka:build wrote' && exit 1)
scripts.check:koka: node scripts/koka-gate.mjs --fixtures fixtures/koka && node scripts/koka-mutations.mjs examples/ingest/core/mutations.mjs examples/fulfil/core/mutations.mjs
scripts.lint:fixtures: node scripts/lint-fixtures.mjs && node scripts/lint-fixtures.mjs fixtures/rules/boundary && node scripts/lint-fixtures.mjs fixtures/rules/effects && node scripts/lint-fixtures.mjs examples/etl/fixtures/rules eslint.examples.js
scripts.check:dts: test -z "$(find src -name '*.d.ts')" || (echo 'src holds compiled modules only; an ambient declaration belongs in a *.typetest.ts' && exit 1)
